top_categories.workout_context: 5,700ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Iron Horse Bicycle Classic's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before race day.

Road-specific control matters at Iron Horse Bicycle Classic. Practice on paved mountain highway with two major passes: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 47 miles.
At Iron Horse Bicycle Classic, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
121ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
5,700ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Iron Horse Bicycle Classic. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
47 miles on paved mountain highway with two major passes burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.

Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on paved mountain highway with two major passes can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Iron Horse Bicycle Classic. Train it until it feels boring.
Base fitness for Iron Horse Bicycle Classic. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Low-cadence force work supports 5,700ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Iron Horse Bicycle Classic's 47 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.
race_overlay.altitude: Iron Horse Bicycle Classic includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing. Temperature drops of 20-30F between Durango and pass summits.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Iron Horse Bicycle Classic rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on paved mountain highway with two major passes to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on VO2max, Race Simulation, and Road Specific to prepare you for 47 miles of paved mountain highway with two major passes in Durango, Colorado.
